# `bs shelf delete`

- **Usage:** `bs shelf delete [--dry-run] <SHELF>`

Delete an empty shelf and its settings/guidance; refuse all other contents

## Arguments
- **`<SHELF>`**

## Flags
- **`--dry-run`** — Validate and preview without changing files
- **`-h --help`** — Print help
